transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

For the past 10 months, I've been struggling with severe, unpredictable mood swings. I alternate between times when I feel extremely down, sad, and empty, and other times when I'm overflowing with energy, hyperactive, and easily irritated. It just feels like I'm constantly shifting between these two extremes and can't find a balance.
During these mood shifts, or even when your mood feels stable, have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or holding beliefs that others found highly unusual?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that at all. I have never heard voices, seen things that aren't really there, or held any unusual beliefs. It has really just been my moods and energy that feel so out of control.
During those times when you feel overflowing with energy, has it ever gotten so intense that it caused major disruptions in your work or relationships, or required you to be hospitalized?

I definitely feel incredibly energetic and try to do way too many things at once during those phases. However, I've never been hospitalized for it, and I'm not really sure if it has caused disruptions that severe. It's mostly just exhausting for me to manage.
When you have these periods of being overflowing with energy and hyperactive, how many days in a row do they typically last?

These periods of high energy and hyperactivity have been happening consistently over the course of the last 10 months. When I get into one of those phases, they usually last for several weeks at a time before my mood shifts again.
During these high-energy weeks, have family, friends, or coworkers commented on how different you seemed, or have you done things that were unusually risky or out of character?
I'm not really sure if anyone has commented on how different I seemed during those times. I also don't think I've done anything particularly risky, I'm just much more active than usual.
When you have those periods of feeling extremely down, sad, and empty, how long do they typically last, and do they make it hard for you to do your daily activities?

Yes, those periods where I feel completely depressed, sad, and empty have been happening off and on for about 10 months. They make it incredibly difficult and exhausting for me to get through my daily activities.
During those down periods, do you feel that sad and empty nearly every day for at least two weeks at a time?

Yes, I do... I feel completely empty and sad almost every single day when I'm in those down phases. And it definitely lasts much longer than just two weeks, usually dragging on for weeks or even months at a time.
During these times of high energy, do you find that you need much less sleep than usual—for example, feeling fully rested after only three or four hours of sleep?
I haven't really noticed a significant change in my sleep during those high-energy times. Honestly, I'm not really sure about my sleep patterns when I feel that way.
During those times when you have a lot of energy, do you notice your thoughts racing or that you are talking much faster than usual?

I haven't really noticed my thoughts racing or talking faster than usual during those times. However, I definitely feel an overflow of physical and mental energy, and there is this constant, restless need to keep moving.
During these high-energy weeks, do you find yourself easily distracted, where your attention is constantly pulled away by minor things around you?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really noticed being easily distracted or having my attention pulled away by minor things during those high-energy times.
